# 2379. Minimum Recolors to Get K Consecutive Black Blocks

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minimumRecolors(self, blocks, k):
        """
        :type blocks: str
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = float("inf")
        cnt = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(blocks):
            if c == "W":
                cnt += 1
            if i >= k and blocks[i - k] == "W":
                cnt -= 1
            if i >= k - 1:
                ans = min(ans, cnt)
        return ans
```
